name: zero-ecs-workspace
description: Workspace for the Zero ECS World, Scheduler and Game libraries.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @zero-ecs/world && npm run build -w @zero-ecs/scheduler && npm run build -w @zero-ecs/game && npm run build -w @zero-ecs/math && npm run build -w @zero-ecs/motion && npm run build -w @zero-ecs/flying-sword
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @zero-ecs/world && npm run typecheck -w @zero-ecs/scheduler && npm run typecheck -w @zero-ecs/game && npm run typecheck -w @zero-ecs/math && npm run typecheck -w @zero-ecs/motion && npm run typecheck -w @zero-ecs/flying-sword
scripts.bench: npm run build && node benchmarks/node.mjs --profile smoke
scripts.bench:core: npm run build && node benchmarks/node.mjs --profile core
scripts.example:breakout: npm run build && rsbuild dev --config examples/breakout/rsbuild.config.ts
scripts.example:breakout:build: npm run build && rsbuild build --config examples/breakout/rsbuild.config.ts
scripts.example:shooter-zombie: npm run build && rsbuild dev --config examples/shooter-zombie/rsbuild.config.ts
scripts.example:shooter-zombie:build: npm run build && rsbuild build --config examples/shooter-zombie/rsbuild.config.ts
scripts.example:flying-sword: npm run build && rsbuild dev --config examples/flying-sword/rsbuild.config.ts
scripts.example:flying-sword:build: npm run build && rsbuild build --config examples/flying-sword/rsbuild.config.ts
scripts.verify:release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:no-jit && tsc -p tests/types/tsconfig.json && node tests/package-boundary.mjs && tsc -p examples/breakout/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/shooter-zombie/tsconfig.json && tsc -p examples/flying-sword/tsconfig.json
